items.Sentence: Each home has a STEP (Septic Tank Effluent Pump) system to pretreat wastewater prior to pumping to the main collection system.
The dosing tank contains a duplex pumping system that sends equal doses to a zoned leach field.
The main line ... delivers effluent to a common dosing tank and a zoned leach field area.
Alternating pumps in the 2,000 gallon dosing tank convey treated effluent to a primary and secondary leach field area, both designed with 1,800 linear foot of pressure dosed dispersal trench.
